$comment: KQL simulator challenges. Each solution is run through the simulator to produce the expected answer, so no expected results are stored. ordered: true when the question asks for a sort order.

challenges.title: How many requests failed?
challenges.description: Count the requests in `requests` that did not succeed. Return a single `Count` column.
hints: `success` is a boolean: compare it with `false`.
The `count` operator returns one row with a `Count` column.
challenges.solution:
requests
| where success == false
| count

challenges.title: Failed requests per hour
challenges.description: Show how many requests failed in each hour. Return `timestamp` (the start of the hour) and `count_`. Add `| render timechart` to see it as a chart.
hints: `bin(timestamp, 1h)` rounds each timestamp down to the hour.
`summarize count() by bin(timestamp, 1h)` - the bin column keeps the name `timestamp`.
challenges.solution:
requests
| where success == false
| summarize count() by bin(timestamp, 1h)
| render timechart

challenges.title: Top 5 slowest operations
challenges.description: Which five operations (`name`) have the highest average `duration`? Return `name` and `avg_duration`, slowest first.
hints: `summarize avg(duration) by name` names the result `avg_duration`.
`top 5 by avg_duration` sorts descending and keeps five rows.
challenges.solution:
requests
| summarize avg(duration) by name
| top 5 by avg_duration

challenges.title: Requests by result code
challenges.description: Count requests by `resultCode`. Return `resultCode` and `count_`.
hints: `resultCode` is a string in Application Insights, not a number.
`summarize count() by resultCode`.
challenges.solution:
requests
| summarize count() by resultCode

challenges.title: Failure rate per role
challenges.description: For each `cloud_RoleName`, return the number of requests (`Total`), how many failed (`Failed`) and the failure percentage rounded to one decimal place (`FailurePct`).
hints: `countif(success == false)` counts only the failures.
Then `extend FailurePct = round(100.0 * Failed / Total, 1)` - the 100.0 avoids integer division.
challenges.solution:
requests
| summarize Total = count(), Failed = countif(success == false) by cloud_RoleName
| extend FailurePct = round(100.0 * Failed / Total, 1)

challenges.title: Requests between 1 and 3 seconds
challenges.description: Count the requests whose `duration` (milliseconds) is between 1,000 and 3,000 inclusive, per operation `name`. Return `name` and `count_`.
hints: `duration between (1000 .. 3000)` is inclusive at both ends.
Then `summarize count() by name`.
challenges.solution:
requests
| where duration between (1000 .. 3000)
| summarize count() by name

challenges.title: Most common exceptions
challenges.description: Which three exception `type`s occur most often? Return `type` and `count_`, most first.
hints: `summarize count() by type`.
`top 3 by count_`.
challenges.solution:
exceptions
| summarize count() by type
| top 3 by count_

challenges.title: Which exceptions break which operations
challenges.description: Join failed requests to `exceptions` on `operation_Id` and count the matches by request `name` and exception `type`. Return `name`, `type` and `count_`.
hints: `join kind=inner (exceptions) on operation_Id` keeps only failed requests that logged an exception.
Then `summarize count() by name, type`.
challenges.solution:
requests
| where success == false
| join kind=inner (exceptions) on operation_Id
| summarize count() by name, type

challenges.title: Failures that left no exception
challenges.description: Some failed requests logged no exception at all - worth knowing, because they will not show up on an exceptions dashboard. Count failed requests with no matching exception. Return a single `Count` column.
hints: A left outer join keeps every failed request; where there is no exception the right-hand columns are empty.
`join kind=leftouter (exceptions | project operation_Id, type) on operation_Id | where isempty(type) | count`.
challenges.solution:
requests
| where success == false
| join kind=leftouter (exceptions | project operation_Id, type) on operation_Id
| where isempty(type)
| count

challenges.title: When did each VM last check in?
challenges.description: Return each `Computer` with the time of its most recent heartbeat, as `LastHeartbeat`.
hints: `summarize LastHeartbeat = max(TimeGenerated) by Computer`.
challenges.solution:
Heartbeat
| summarize LastHeartbeat = max(TimeGenerated) by Computer

challenges.title: VMs with no heartbeat in 15 minutes
challenges.description: The classic "is the agent down?" alert query: find computers whose last heartbeat is older than 15 minutes. Return `Computer` and `LastHeartbeat`.
hints: First find each computer's last heartbeat with `max(TimeGenerated)`.
Then keep the ones where `LastHeartbeat < ago(15m)`. Filtering before summarize would give the wrong answer - why?
challenges.solution:
Heartbeat
| summarize LastHeartbeat = max(TimeGenerated) by Computer
| where LastHeartbeat < ago(15m)

challenges.title: Average CPU in the last hour
challenges.description: Average `% Processor Time` per `Computer` over the last hour, rounded to one decimal place. Return `Computer` and `AvgCpu`, busiest first.
hints: Filter on `CounterName == "% Processor Time"` and `TimeGenerated > ago(1h)`.
`summarize AvgCpu = round(avg(CounterValue), 1) by Computer | order by AvgCpu desc`.
challenges.solution:
Perf
| where CounterName == "% Processor Time" and TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| summarize AvgCpu = round(avg(CounterValue), 1) by Computer
| order by AvgCpu desc

challenges.title: VMs running hot
challenges.description: Which computers averaged more than 80% CPU over the whole six hours? Return `Computer` and `avg_CounterValue`.
hints: Aggregate first with `summarize avg(CounterValue) by Computer`.
Then `where avg_CounterValue > 80`.
challenges.solution:
Perf
| where ObjectName == "Processor" and CounterName == "% Processor Time"
| summarize avg(CounterValue) by Computer
| where avg_CounterValue > 80

challenges.title: Disks running out of space
challenges.description: Find computers whose `% Free Space` dropped below 15% at any point. Return `Computer` and `MinFreePct` (the lowest value seen).
hints: `summarize MinFreePct = min(CounterValue) by Computer`.
Then filter on `MinFreePct < 15`.
challenges.solution:
Perf
| where CounterName == "% Free Space"
| summarize MinFreePct = min(CounterValue) by Computer
| where MinFreePct < 15

challenges.title: Failed sign-ins per user
challenges.description: Count failed sign-ins (any `ResultType` other than `"0"`) per `UserPrincipalName`. Return `UserPrincipalName` and `Failures`, most first.
hints: `ResultType` is a string - compare with `"0"`, in quotes.
`summarize Failures = count() by UserPrincipalName | order by Failures desc`.
challenges.solution:
SigninLogs
| where ResultType != "0"
| summarize Failures = count() by UserPrincipalName
| order by Failures desc, UserPrincipalName asc

challenges.title: Spot a password spray
challenges.description: A password spray tries many accounts from one place. Find IP addresses with more than 10 failed sign-ins, and how many different accounts they tried. Return `IPAddress`, `Failures` and `Accounts`.
hints: `summarize Failures = count(), Accounts = dcount(UserPrincipalName) by IPAddress` over failed sign-ins.
Then `where Failures > 10`.
challenges.solution:
SigninLogs
| where ResultType != "0"
| summarize Failures = count(), Accounts = dcount(UserPrincipalName) by IPAddress
| where Failures > 10

challenges.title: Users signing in from several places
challenges.description: Which users had successful sign-ins from more than one `Location`? Return `UserPrincipalName` and `Locations` (the number of distinct locations).
hints: Successful sign-ins have `ResultType == "0"`.
`dcount(Location)` counts distinct locations; then keep `Locations > 1`.
challenges.solution:
SigninLogs
| where ResultType == "0"
| summarize Locations = dcount(Location) by UserPrincipalName
| where Locations > 1

challenges.title: Who deleted what?
challenges.description: List every successful delete operation: `TimeGenerated`, `Caller`, `OperationNameValue` and `_ResourceId`, newest first.
hints: Delete operations end in `/DELETE`: use `endswith`.
Keep `ActivityStatusValue == "Success"`, then `project` the columns and `order by TimeGenerated desc`.
challenges.solution:
AzureActivity
| where OperationNameValue endswith "/DELETE" and ActivityStatusValue == "Success"
| project TimeGenerated, Caller, OperationNameValue, _ResourceId
| order by TimeGenerated desc

challenges.title: Failed operations per caller
challenges.description: Count failed operations (`ActivityStatusValue == "Failure"`) per `Caller`. Return `Caller` and `count_`.
hints: `where ActivityStatusValue == "Failure"`.
`summarize count() by Caller`.
challenges.solution:
AzureActivity
| where ActivityStatusValue == "Failure"
| summarize count() by Caller

challenges.title: Who changed network security groups?
challenges.description: Return the distinct `Caller`s who changed or deleted NSG rules - operations whose name contains `networksecuritygroups/securityrules` - in the last 12 hours.
hints: `contains` is case-insensitive, so the lower-case text matches the upper-case operation names.
`TimeGenerated > ago(12h)`, then `distinct Caller`.
challenges.solution:
AzureActivity
| where TimeGenerated > ago(12h) and OperationNameValue contains "networksecuritygroups/securityrules"
| distinct Caller
